title: plantuml-server: 1.2026.5 -> 1.2026.6 + switch to jetty 12
structural_notes: Diff touches the packages.jetty mkPackageOption declaration block (default changes from [ "jetty_11" ] to [ "jetty_12" ], the extraDescription block explaining the jetty-12 unsupported warning is deleted) and the jetty startup script's --module list / arg-flag syntax (--module=deploy,http,jsp -> --module=http,ee11-deploy,ee11-jsp, and jetty.* args gain a -D prefix). packages.jdk's mkPackageOption declaration is unchanged. Watched: baseline enable + packages.jetty (its mkPackageOption declaration line/default is directly touched). nixos/tests/plantuml-server.nix (identical base/head) only sets services.plantuml-server.enable = true; packages.jetty is left at its module default in the test, i.e. no test assignment for packages.jetty on either side.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: packages.jetty is declared via mkPackageOption inside a plain nested attrset (options.services.plantuml-server.packages = { jdk = mkPackageOption ...; jetty = mkPackageOption ...; };), not a top-level mkOption. Consistent with the pattern seen in batch8/524479 (aesmd's settings.* nested-attrset options also all showed OptionNotFound in check's discovered_options despite being real, present option declarations), the check command's option-discovery walk does not register packages.jetty as a discovered option on either side, so its verdict is OptionNotFound both sides -- not counted as a PASS-needing-review case. Raw fact only, no diagnosis attempted about why discovery misses this shape.
